title: Optical Phase Noise and Polarization Fluctuation Measurement with Delay Interferometer
text: In this paper, we report experimental results that a delay interferometer can measure the signal light's optical phase noise and polarization fluctuation in the single-mode fibers with reasonable accuracy.
